svg.title: Two tunnels on your PC: the more specific route wins
svg.desc: With both clients connected, your PC's WireGuard route covers 10.64.0.0/13, every lab slot, while the Azure VPN Client adds a route for vnet-hub's /20, which is more specific. So traffic to vm-app goes over point-to-site to vpngw-hub, signed in with Entra ID and given an address from the client pool, and goes back over WireGuard when you disconnect.
